verdict.rationale: The evidence covers continuous data forwarding, audience connections to outputs, Warehouse Sync ingestion, and an AI assistant that suggests audience or journey logic. None of it documents a user-configurable automation, workflow, or agent that runs autonomously in the background. Ongoing audience syncs and data pipelines are adjacent pipeline behavior, not the automation capability this story asks for, and no recurring schedule or trigger-based automation is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
